title: Molecular iodine catalyzed C3-quaternization via oxidative dearomatization of indoles: direct access to 3,3-di(indolyl)indolin-2-ones
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7967-7973
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00218H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Neetika Singh, Hari Prasad Kokatla, Nagaraju Naddi, Madhu Inapanuri
Molecular iodine promotes the direct synthesis of 3,3-diindolyl-indoline-2-one from indole via oxidative dearomatization. The reaction proceeds through in situ isatin formation, offering a green, metal-free pathway to C3-quaternized indoles.
